Dragonborn Culture

Dragonborn Fenari adorn themselves with jewelry and dazzling apparel in an attempt to emulate the natural scales of their hosts. This extends even to their armor; many favor Scale Mail even when it hinders more than it helps.

Over the generations these Fenari grow draconic horns, soft scales spread over their skin in place of fur, and their ears take on a pointed look. Eventually they develop the same breath sacs as their Dragonborn kith.

Alignment. Dragonborn Fenari tend to lean more toward good than evil.

Fenari Traits

  • Size. Fenari grow between 4'0" and 5'2" tall and weigh 70 to 120 pounds. Your size is Small or Medium (choose when you select this species).
  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Languages. Common and Draconic.
  • Scale Color. Choose the color of your scales; it sets your Dragon's Breath damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison).
  • Dragon's Breath. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line of energy (Dexterity save, DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus) dealing 1d10 damage, rising to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th. Uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

See the The Fenari journal for the Fenari's history, Creed, and appearance.
